newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.02 rupees up at 42.17 to the dollar in the kerb market on Thursday on higher dollar supplies from abroad, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open stable after the Friday weekend, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 5.20 percent compared with the opening at 5.10 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
